name: Bulgaria

train.sum: Sofia Central Station (Tsentralna gara) is the main station and has its own metro stop. BDZ runs domestic trains to Plovdiv, Burgas, Varna, Ruse and western Bulgaria, plus international trains to Istanbul and Bucharest.
train.sched: Long-distance trains run through the day, and overnight trains with sleeper cars run to Varna and Burgas. Check the BDZ timetable on the day you travel, because engineering works and power failures often replace sections with buses.
tickets: Sofia to Istanbul (Halkali) night train: 26.40 EUR in 2nd class, 39.60 EUR in 1st class, one way
Istanbul night train reservations: couchette from 10 EUR, berth 15 EUR, single compartment 35 EUR
Sofia to Bucharest: about 36 EUR in 2nd class, with a compulsory reservation
Fast domestic trains to Plovdiv, Varna, Burgas and Ruse: seat reservation about 0.25 EUR
Children 4 to 7 pay 6.20 EUR and children 7 to 12 pay 13.20 EUR on the Istanbul train. Under 4 travel free
train.tip: Book the night train to Istanbul and the train to Bucharest ahead, and buy domestic tickets early for summer weekends to the Black Sea.
buy: Ticket offices at Sofia Central Station and other stations. Leave at least 30 minutes for the queue
Rila agencies at larger stations sell reservations for international trains
Sofia to Bucharest international tickets are sold on the Romanian railways site bileteinternationale.cfrcalatori.ro
Buy before you board. The rules for paying the conductor are published on the BDZ site

destinations.note: Via Plovdiv or Karlovo. Overnight trains with sleeper cars also run
Via Pleven. Change here for the trains to Romania in autumn and winter
Day trains and overnight trains with sleeper cars
Direct train from 13 June to 12 October 2026. At other times, change at Ruse. Dates for 2027 are not announced, and the Ruse to Giurgiu line may close for works from April 2027
Night train via Plovdiv, leaves about 18:45. Halkali is on the edge of Istanbul, so continue by metro or Marmaray

tram.sum: Sofia has trams, trolleybuses and buses run by the Center for Urban Mobility, plus a separate metro. One ticket system covers all of them.
tram.sched: Daytime lines run from early morning to late evening, with night lines after that. The 24-hour and 72-hour cards include night transport. Check line times at sofiatraffic.bg.
tickets: Day card (calendar day, all lines): 2.00 EUR
Children under 7 travel free. Sofia City Card costs 1.50 EUR and the Ultralight card 0.40 EUR, one time
tram.tip: Tap a contactless bank card on the blue validator each time you board. From the third trip in a day you pay no more than the 2.00 EUR day price.
buy: Contactless bank card, phone or watch on the blue validator on trams, trolleybuses and buses (charged as ticket 30+)
Ticket machines at metro station entrances
Metro cashier desks and Center for Urban Mobility desks (cards and passes)
Not from the driver. Tap a contactless card on board instead
Fine for travelling without a valid ticket: 20 EUR

bus.sum: City buses and trolleybuses cover the districts the tram and metro do not reach. Intercity coaches connect Sofia with the rest of Bulgaria.
bus.sched: Daytime city lines run from early morning to late evening, with night lines after that. Intercity coaches run through the day, so check the operator's timetable.
tickets: City bus and trolleybus: same fares as the tram, 0.80 EUR for ticket 30+ and 1.10 EUR for ticket 60+
Day card 2.00 EUR, 24-hour card 3.00 EUR, 72-hour card 7.60 EUR
Night lines: covered by the 24-hour and 72-hour cards, or pay with a contactless card
Monthly pass for all lines: 25.50 EUR with a personal card
bus.tip: One ticket 30+ lets you change between bus, trolleybus, tram and metro within 30 minutes of the first validation.
buy: Contactless bank card, phone or watch on the validator on board
Sofia City Card or Ultralight card loaded at metro cashier desks and Center for Urban Mobility desks
Ticket machines at metro station entrances
Not from the driver. Tap a contactless card on board instead
Intercity coaches: buy online or at the coach station from the operator

airport.sum: Sofia Airport (SOF) is about 10 km east of the centre. Terminal 2 has its own metro station, and Terminal 1 is linked to it by a free shuttle bus.
airport.sched: The metro runs from about 05:30 to midnight and takes about 20 minutes to Serdika in the centre. Buses 84 and 184 run to the centre during the day.
tickets: Metro to the centre: ticket 30+ at 0.80 EUR, or tap a contactless bank card
Bus 84 or 184 to General Gurko Street: 0.80 EUR for ticket 30+
Taxi: book at the OK Supertrans desk in the arrival hall, or at oktaxi.net or +359 2 973 2121
Uber does not operate in Bulgaria
airport.tip: Use the metro from Terminal 2. If you land at Terminal 1, take the free shuttle bus between the terminals first.
buy: Metro: ticket machines or cashier desk in the airport metro station, or tap a contactless bank card at the barriers
Buses 84 and 184: ticket machine at Terminal 1, Center for Urban Mobility kiosks in Terminal 2, or tap a contactless card on board
Taxi: only at the licensed OK Supertrans desk, to avoid overcharging

metro.note: Sofia has four metro lines, M1 to M4. Lines M1 and M2 cross at Serdika in the centre, and the airport and Central Station both have their own stations. Line M3 is separate from the others.
metro.mapLabel: Sofia metro map and track layout (UrbanRail.Net)
lines: Four lines, M1 to M4. Line M3 runs on its own and does not join the other three
Serdika is the main interchange between M1 and M2
Central Railway Station (Tsentralna gara) is on the metro, next to the BDZ station
Sofia Airport station is next to Terminal 2
The metro runs from about 05:30 to midnight, every 2 to 7 minutes in the day

tips: Prices are in euros since 1 January 2026. Old ticket and card balances in levs can still be used until they expire.
Contactless bank cards work in the metro and on surface transport, so you do not need to buy a card or ticket.
Use the same bank card for every trip on a day, so the daily cap of 2.00 EUR applies.
Train timetables change often because of engineering works. Check BDZ live updates before a long trip.
